products.title: Timberland Adventure Seeker Closed-Toe Sandal (Toddler/Little Kid)
products.description: Help them stay comfortable throughout spring with the exceptional Timberland Adventure Seeker Closed Toe Youth Sandal, formerly called the Mad River Sandal. Great for everyday wear, their little feet will stay comfortable and protected all-day long thanks to its EVA footbed and rubber outsole. Boasting of a lightweight and water-friendly upper, it features two adjustable straps with hook-and-loop closure for a great fit. Sanitized anti-microbial treatment helps keep their feet comforted and odor-free all-day long. Make this summer one to remember with the new Timberland Adventure Seeker Closed Toe Sandal Youth Timberland set new industry standards for craftsmanship, durability and protection when it introduced an authentic, waterproof leather boot in 1973. A global leader in design, engineering and marketing of premium footwear, Timberland values consumers who cherish the outdoors and their time in it. Timberland has been an industry leader in the use of both sustainable and recycled materials in its shoes, as well as its footwear packaging. products.description: Boys Old West Boots: Boys Old West Western Cowboy Boots. Durable and comfortable enough for everyday wear. These boy's cowboy boots by Old West have fancy stitching on the 9" shaft, double row welt stitch, removable cushion comfort insole, broad square toe, 15/16" heel and flexible TPR outsole. They pull on with easy pull straps. Made from 100% man made materials. VB9113

products.title: adidas Men's Solarthon Primegreen Spikeless Golf Shoes
products.description: Inspired by long summer days, these golf shoes prioritize comfort. From the Boost midsole for an energized feel to a soft, breathable upper, they support your feet from the front nine to the back and beyond. The lightweight, water-repellent design keeps feet dry and comfortable. A spikeless outsole grips the green and ensures easy transitions off the course. This product is made with Primegreen, a series of high-performance recycled materials.

products.title: Saucony Men's Peregrine 8 ICE+ Sneaker
products.description: Featuring vibrant Artic grip outsole, the peregrine 8 ice+ turns cold weather from an excuse to a bonus. The proprietary outsole compound utilizes wet ice tech to keep you pushing the pace without slipping, and Everun cushioning ensures you can lay fresh tracks for miles. Saucony is among the most respected names in running shoes. We offer a wide range of running and walking shoes, each with the Saucony trademark fit, feel and performance. We've spent years studying the biomechanics of top athletes. Our goal? To develop creatively engineered systems that maximize your performance in your specific activity, allowing you to focus on the activity instead of the equipment. From our studies have come many innovative Saucony concepts. Advanced technologies-like Grid, the first sole-based stability and cushioning system--provide an advantage to athletes of all types.

products.title: Columbia Kids' Youth Drainmaker IV Water Shoe
products.description: Your kid will think it’s cool that this hybrid shoe literally drains water, while you can feel good knowing it’s quick drying, lightweight, and super supportive for their little feet.    This ideal all-season sneaker keeps little feet happy with a combination of mesh and textile upper that delivers comfort and functionality for all day wear. The TechLite cupsole midsole delivers long lasting support, while the Omni-Grip non-marking traction rubber offers great dockside to pavement performance. Columbia offers these kids shoes in multiple colors, with true-to-size fit.

products.title: KEEN Women's Lorelai Slip-on Loafer Flat
products.description: Effortless style meets endless comfort in this women's slip-on. Featuring premium, environmentally preferred leather, Direct-attach construction to minimize glue, and our lighter-than-air luftcell outsole.

dialogue.user: Hmm, a few of those don't seem to be for running. For example, the Timberland sandal and the KEEN loafer don't sound like they'd be suitable for running. Could you tell me more about the adidas Men's Solarthon Primegreen Spikeless Golf Shoes and the Saucony Men's Peregrine 8 ICE+ Sneaker? Are they definitely good for running, and are they waterproof?
dialogue.agent:
The **adidas Men's Solarthon Primegreen Spikeless Golf Shoes** are described as "lightweight, water-repellent" and suitable for golf, with a comfortable Boost midsole. The reviews mention they are very comfortable for walking and have excellent grip, but one reviewer noted they wished Adidas made a waterproof model.

The **Saucony Men's Peregrine 8 ICE+ Sneaker** features a Vibram Artic Grip outsole with wet ice tech for traction and Everun cushioning for comfort. While designed for icy conditions and running, its waterproof capabilities are not explicitly stated.

Both shoes are within your budget and have high ratings. Would you like to know more about either of these?

top_reviews.title: Super comfy, excellent grip
top_reviews.text: My first time wearing them was during a full weekend of golf. 36 holes and a whole lot of walking. These were extremely comfortable after both days. Excellent grip off the tee's and on the course.

top_reviews.title: Most comfortable golf shoe ever
top_reviews.text: I've owned maybe 7 or 8 pairs of golf shoes. These are the most comfortable. True Linskwear are close. These are even more comfy than Adidas Ultra Boost because of the adjustable tongue and extra heel pad. I only wish Adidas came out with a darker black colorway and a waterproof model.

top_reviews.title: Great shoes
top_reviews.text: These golf shoes are very comfortable.  I purchased a second pair in case they go out of stock.  I don’t play early mornings so not sure if water proof.  Overall really enjoy wearing them.

dialogue.user: It sounds like the Saucony Men's Peregrine 8 ICE+ Sneaker might be closer to what I'm looking for if it's good for running and has traction in slippery conditions. The description for the adidas shoes mentioned "water-repellent," which isn't quite what I need either. I'm really hoping for something that will keep my feet dry in wet weather while I'm running. Do you have any shoes that are explicitly advertised as waterproof and good for running, and still fall within my $50-$100 budget?
